mentions.heading: AI adoption risks including hardware constraints and third-party dependence
mentions.detail: AI depends on third-party models, cloud, infrastructure; GPU availability and power capacity constraints; competitive AI adoption risk
mentions.quote: Because our AI capabilities currently depend in part on third-party providers of models, cloud services and infrastructure, changes in their performance, pricing, licensing terms or availability could materially increase our costs.

mentions.heading: A disruption in our information technology systems, including cybersecurity, could adversely affect our financial performance
mentions.detail: Ransomware targeting manufacturers; connected vehicle systems hold end-user data; extortion payments may be legally prohibited
mentions.quote: In particular, ransomware or other attacks that are intended to disrupt our and our customers' business operations are becoming increasingly prevalent, particularly for manufacturing companies, and can lead to significant interruptions in operations and the ability to provide products or services, loss of sensitive data and income, reputational harm and diversion of funds.

mentions.heading: Cyber incidents at customers reduce demand
mentions.detail: 2025 cybersecurity incident at a major customer disrupted its production, reducing demand for Lear components and hitting results
mentions.quote: Additionally, in 2025, a cybersecurity incident affecting one of our major customers disrupted its production systems, which in turn reduced demand for our components and impacted our operating results.

mentions.heading: Compromise of products could affect many customers simultaneously
mentions.detail: Embedded in many customers' supply chains globally; contracts may lack liability limits; large-scale event could be catastrophic
mentions.quote: Our contracts with customers and others may not contain limitations of liability, and even where they do, there can be no assurances that limitations of liability in our contracts are sufficient to protect us from liabilities, damages or claims related to our security obligations.
